findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed an employee fail to use a barrier to turn off the hand sink. Since the faucet is turned on with dirty hands, touching the faucet again after washing results in cross-contamination. Educated was conducted regarding proper hand washing. Ensure staff are using a clean barrier such as a disposable paper towel to turn off the hand sink after washing.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: Observed no managers working to have their CFM license. Ensure managers are licensed and show the certificate to inspectors during inspections.
(A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.citation_text:
6-202.11  (C)  Lighting was found not shielded or otherwise protected in the dry storage area. Light bulbs shall be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Reference 6-202.11.

Observed a light shield to be missing in the dry storage area. Replace light shield.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Broken light shield in dry storage area.  Replace shield

750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed blue and white plastic protective wrap to be on the bottoms of the sinks and other equipment. Remove plastic protective wrap.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed single service, wrapped straws being stored on a shelf below the trash cans in the dining room service area. Store straws so that they are protected from the potential for contamination.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.
